scope: Two existing private production composition boundaries only. No source/ref/worktree mutation, no tests run, no wire/digest/contract/role/visibility/caller-set change.

issue.known_complete_combination: Primary EligibleForIndependentSelection and one or more retained members Ineligible.
issue.original_gap: require_observed_panel rejects unknown members but accepts known Ineligible retention. Original Evaluation receipt owner consumes only the primary qualification. material authenticates all members but derives Qualified solely from primary.qualified.
issue.no_false_execution_claim: No valid full-signature positive-primary/negative-retention ordinary execution has been reproduced. The current actual original provider fixtures produce complete negative comparisons.
issue.semantic_limit: The comparisons may be complete. Refusal is not missing-data classification, not Objective Fraud, and not a new aggregate NoUpdate. No existing result is rewritten or re-signed. A complete aggregate NoUpdate needs an explicit original-owner aggregate contract in separate work.
issue.conservative_policy: Every frozen member currently includes PrimarySuperiority. An Ineligible result may mean lack of required superiority rather than a regression. This preparation does not reinterpret it as a noninferiority pass.

condition.panel: After all existing unknown/member/complete-retention-digest checks: if primary == EligibleForIndependentSelection and any retention != EligibleForIndependentSelection, return original PanelError::Binding.
condition.material: After every member, panel digest and original primary receipt binding is verified: if primary.qualified and any retained member has !qualified, return original CommandError::Binding. member::verify already rejects the InsufficientEvidence disposition tag.
condition.error_message: qualified original B requires eligible retention
preservation: Primary Ineligible plus any known, fully authenticated retention results continues through the existing honest NoUpdate path.
Any InsufficientEvidence member remains refused by the pre-existing unknown checks.
Primary Eligible plus all Eligible retention passes this new local condition; all other current authority, binding, signature and owner checks remain required.
Empty, substituted, stale, revoked, incomplete or changed material remains subject to all earlier failures.

integration.before_receipt: Owners::read_original_completion calls read_panel before OriginalCellEvaluationReceiptOwnerV1::attest_original_completion/readback. read_original_panel calls require_observed_panel before sealing.
integration.after_receipt: read_original_completion reads the panel again before the final receipt return. The same new guard is therefore rechecked; existing host error/fence semantics remain unchanged.
integration.export_and_current_use: original_model_material rechecks verify::material after I/O; OriginalCellEvaluationModelMaterialV1::authenticate_current and require_original_model_input call that same verifier.
integration.panel_error: OriginalCellEvaluationPanelErrorV1::Binding -> existing OriginalCellEvaluationCommandErrorV1::Panel wrapper; no Completed response or replacement learning observation.

caller_contract_impact.note: Only inserted conditionals; no old marker removed or reordered, no new privileged symbol or product caller. Full canonical source gate has not been run for these postimages.

regression_plan.reason: No test-only qualification forging API or visibility expansion was introduced. Existing PanelMemberFixture::complete computes Ineligible from actual original supported policies; its assertion and all source/signature proofs are unchanged. A positive signed aggregate cannot honestly be fabricated from it.
regression_plan.targeted_preservation: Existing actual negative panel -> original signed NoUpdate -> material readback with rejected Model input, plus missing/withdrawn/unknown evidence refusal.
regression_plan.unexecuted_positive_coverage_limit: The new rejection condition needs independent source review. No full-signature positive-primary/negative-retention execution test or actual FAIL control has been run or claimed.
regression_plan.followup: After a new frozen candidate is authorized, run the existing original just entry point on the relevant agentd tests and original source gates; preserve the separate e8b6 results. Do not call cargo test.
